The platform benchmark's capability cards for the `ryzen-9-8945hs` machine described on the
[benchmark systems](systems.md) page: every operation family, measured against this
machine's FMA peak and memory bandwidth (#721). This page shows the latest published
session; every session's raw results stay in the data directory.

Repeatability: 580 of 666 entries within +-5% of the previous session, measured after a cold boot on the same commit (median ratio 0.998; benchmarks/compare_sessions.py). The background_activity records show a Defender security-intelligence update at 03:22Z during this session's native-t8 run, the run with the most entries outside the band; no Defender scan ran in either session. Relates to #721 and #737.
